source.note: Written by the repository author for the v0.4.0 follow-up (tempting-correct repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Let the invoice list API sort by created date, total or id, ascending or descending (query params ?sort=&dir=).
constraints: PostgreSQL via node-postgres: values are bound as $n parameters, identifiers cannot be.
input.context: Node.js 20 API (ESM, JSDoc). The status filter is already a bound parameter. sort and dir come straight from the query string.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: flagging the template-string SQL as SQL injection, although only allowlisted constants are interpolated and identifiers cannot be parameterized.
